recipes.title: Analyze an existing MD trajectory for stability, flexibility, and contacts
recipes.summary: Drive the MDAnalysis skill (MDTraj as backup) to take a finished GROMACS/AMBER/NAMD trajectory through RMSD/RMSF/Rg, contact maps, H-bonds, and PCA without writing the analysis script by hand.

recipes.title: Analyze the SAR of a measured compound series
recipes.summary: Drive the SAR Analysis skill over a CSV of assayed analogs to decompose the common scaffold, tabulate R-group vs potency, and surface activity cliffs for the next lead-optimization round.

recipes.title: Analyze a single-cell TCR repertoire alongside gene expression
recipes.summary: Use the scirpy Analysis skill to QC paired single-cell TCR chains, define clonotypes, quantify clonal expansion, and overlay clonality on the transcriptomic UMAP.

recipes.title: Annotate a single bacterial genome assembly
recipes.summary: Use the Bakta Claude skill to annotate one bacterial or archaeal assembly — CDS, rRNA/tRNA, CRISPR arrays — into NCBI-compatible GFF3/GenBank with a feature summary.

recipes.title: Annotate and verify an engineered plasmid construct
recipes.summary: Use the pLannotate skill to auto-annotate an engineered plasmid — promoters, resistance markers, origins, tags — and verify a construct's sequence before you clone or order it.

recipes.title: Annotate cell types in a single-cell dataset
recipes.summary: Use the SciAgent CellTypist skill to put reference-backed cell-type labels on a QC'd AnnData, escalating to the popV consensus skill when you need ensemble uncertainty.

recipes.title: Annotate tumor somatic variants with clinical actionability evidence
recipes.summary: Use the CIViC connector to match a tumor's somatic variant list to predictive/prognostic/diagnostic clinical evidence and produce an AMP/ASCO/CAP-tiered, cited actionability table for a molecular tumor board.

recipes.title: Assemble a public cancer imaging cohort from NCI Imaging Data Commons
recipes.summary: Use the Imaging Data Commons skill to query NCI IDC by modality, body part, and collection, then download a reproducible DICOM cohort ready for segmentation.

recipes.title: Assemble a tissue reference atlas from the CELLxGENE Census
recipes.summary: Use the cellxgene-census Claude skill to slice a tissue- or disease-specific AnnData from the CZ CELLxGENE Census, optionally fetching the precomputed scVI embedding for reference mapping or downstream integration.

recipes.title: Benchmark an ADMET property with PyTDC
recipes.summary: Drive the PyTDC Claude skill to load a Therapeutics Data Commons ADMET dataset with its leaderboard split, train or score a baseline model, and emit the standard TDC metrics so a new method can be compared head-to-head against the leaderboard.

recipes.title: Build a resting-state functional-connectivity matrix from preprocessed fMRI
recipes.summary: Use the Nilearn skill in Claude Code to turn fMRIPrep-preprocessed BOLD into an atlas ROI-to-ROI functional-connectivity matrix with confound regression, as a re-runnable script.

recipes.title: Build a pharmacogenomic dosing report from a patient's diplotypes
recipes.summary: Turn a patient's PGx diplotypes plus a medication list into CPIC/DPWG genotype-to-dosing recommendations with cited guideline sources.

recipes.title: Build a phylogenetic tree from a set of sequences
recipes.summary: Use the phylogenetics Claude skill to take a FASTA of homologous sequences through MAFFT alignment, IQ-TREE 2 maximum-likelihood inference with bootstrap support, and an annotated tree figure.

recipes.title: Build a protein interaction network and rank hub genes
recipes.summary: Feed a gene list to the STRING skill to build a PPI network, then rank hub proteins by degree/centrality and detect modules — the canonical "which of these genes matter most" step.

recipes.title: Build a target dossier from gene name to structure to cancer dependency
recipes.summary: Combine the Open Targets plugin, UniProt MCP, AlphaFold MCP, and the DepMap skill to produce a one-page dossier on a candidate gene — disease evidence, protein annotation, predicted structure, and cancer-cell-line essentiality.

recipes.title: Call peaks and find enriched motifs from ChIP-seq or ATAC-seq
recipes.summary: Chain the MACS3 peak-calling skill into the HOMER motif skill to turn aligned ChIP-seq/ATAC-seq BAMs into a called-peak set with nearest-gene annotation and enriched TF motifs.

recipes.title: Compute 16S microbiome alpha/beta diversity from a BIOM table
recipes.summary: Use the scikit-bio Claude skill to take a BIOM feature table and sample metadata through Shannon/Simpson/Faith's PD, UniFrac, PCoA, and PERMANOVA in one chat.

recipes.title: Compute a bacterial pan-genome from a set of genome assemblies
recipes.summary: Annotate a panel of bacterial assemblies with Bakta, then cluster genes into core/accessory partitions with Roary to get a pan-genome and presence/absence matrix.

recipes.title: Compute DTI scalar maps (FA/MD/AD/RD) from diffusion MRI
recipes.summary: Use the DIPY skill in Claude Code to fit a diffusion tensor to a DWI volume and emit FA/MD/AD/RD maps plus ROI statistics, as a re-runnable script.

recipes.title: Compute HRV from an ECG recording
recipes.summary: Use the NeuroKit2 Claude Skill to clean an ECG trace, detect R-peaks, and return time-domain, frequency-domain, and non-linear HRV indices from a single conversation.

recipes.title: Convert raw analytical instrument data to Allotrope ASM JSON
recipes.summary: Drop a raw instrument file (cell counter, plate reader, HPLC, qPCR) onto Claude Code and get back valid Allotrope Simple Model JSON, a flattened CSV for LIMS, and a standalone Python parser script.

recipes.title: Design CRISPR sgRNAs for a gene knockout
recipes.summary: Use the sgRNA Design skill to pick CRISPR-Cas9 knockout guides for a gene — preferring validated/CRISPick guides, falling back to Rule Set 2 + CFD de novo rules.

recipes.title: Design amino-acid sequences for a fixed protein backbone
recipes.summary: Design sequences for a target backbone with ProteinMPNN, then refold each candidate with ESMFold and keep only those whose self-consistency RMSD recovers the backbone.

recipes.title: Detect somatic copy-number variants from tumor sequencing
recipes.summary: Use the CNVkit Claude Skill to call somatic gene amplifications and deletions from tumor WES/targeted-panel BAMs and export segmented, plotted copy-number profiles.

recipes.title: Diagnose a rare disease from patient phenotypes
recipes.summary: Use the ToolUniverse Rare Disease Diagnosis skill to turn a patient's HPO phenotypes and candidate variants into a tiered, ACMG-aligned differential with prioritized genes.

recipes.title: Discover NWB recordings on DANDI and prepare them for sorting
recipes.summary: Use the Neurosift Tools MCP to find Neuropixels (or other extracellular) NWB sessions on DANDI matching your hypothesis, inspect them in-place, and stage a download list for downstream spike sorting.

recipes.title: Dock a ligand library into a target structure with DiffDock
recipes.summary: Drive DiffDock from Claude Code to generate per-ligand binding poses against a PDB or AlphaFold target, filter by confidence, and emit a ranked pose set ready for MM/PBSA rescoring or visualization.

recipes.title: Draft a Phase 2/3 clinical-trial protocol from an indication brief
recipes.summary: Use the Anthropic clinical-trial-protocol plugin to expand a short indication / endpoint brief into an FDA/NIH-compliant Phase 2/3 protocol draft, with regulatory pathway, competitive landscape, and sample-size calculation already wired in.

recipes.title: Enumerate analogs around a lead compound for SAR expansion
recipes.summary: Use the Datamol skill in Claude Code to enumerate standardized, drug-like analogs around a lead SMILES — tautomers, stereoisomers, and fragment-substituted variants — as a ranked SAR-expansion table.

recipes.title: Estimate pharmacokinetic properties of a small molecule
recipes.summary: Combine RDKit physchem descriptors, MedChem rule-based ADMET flags, and measured ChEMBL bioactivity / DMPK endpoints to build a defensible PK estimate for one compound without an ML predictor in the loop.

recipes.title: Extract event-related potentials from EEG epochs
recipes.summary: Use the MNE-Python EEG skill in Claude Code to filter, ICA-clean, epoch around event markers, and average a raw continuous EEG file into per-condition evoked responses.

recipes.title: Extract structured variables from free-text clinical notes
recipes.summary: Use Claude Code alone to extract predefined variables from de-identified clinical notes into a reviewable, provenance-tracked registry table.

recipes.title: Filter a virtual screening hit list with drug-likeness rules and structural alerts
recipes.summary: Use the MedChem skill in Claude Code to cascade Lipinski / Veber / PAINS / BRENK filters over a SMILES hit list and emit a triaged CSV with per-rule flags and a final keep/drop column.

recipes.title: Find drug-repurposing candidates by walking a biomedical knowledge graph
recipes.summary: Walk PrimeKG offline from a disease through its genes to the drugs that target them, then flag drugs whose current indications are elsewhere as repurposing leads.

recipes.title: Find selective genetic dependencies for a cancer context with DepMap
recipes.summary: Use the DepMap skill to mine genome-wide CRISPR screens for genes selectively essential in a cancer lineage or genotype, corrected for copy-number bias.

recipes.title: Fit a survival model to censored clinical outcomes
recipes.summary: Use the scikit-survival Claude Skill to fit Cox and Random Survival Forest models to censored time-to-event data and report concordance with proper validation.

recipes.title: Generate falsification-tested drug-repurposing hypotheses across corpora
recipes.summary: Use the Hypothesis Crucible plugin to mine typed knowledge fragments from literature, Open Targets/ChEMBL/ClinicalTrials, and raw experimental data (GEO), bridge them Swanson-style into candidate drug-disease connections, then aggressively reject the non-novel, ungrounded, contradicted, and implausible — surfacing only survivors with a fragment-cited mechanism and a falsifiable experiment.

recipes.title: Harmonize free-text clinical terms to standard codes
recipes.summary: Use the Medical Terminologies MCP to map a column of free-text diagnoses, drugs, or labs to ICD-11/SNOMED/RxNorm/LOINC codes as a committed, reviewable crosswalk.

recipes.title: Identify a bacterial isolate from its 16S rRNA sequence
recipes.summary: Use the BLAST MCP server to search a Sanger 16S rRNA read against a pinned reference database and assign genus/species by the standard identity thresholds.

recipes.title: Identify an unknown compound from an MS/MS spectrum
recipes.summary: Use the matchms skill in Claude Code to clean an unknown MS/MS spectrum and rank candidate identities by spectral similarity against a reference library.

recipes.title: Infer cell-cell communication from single-cell RNA-seq
recipes.summary: Use the LIANA-MCP server to run multiple ligand-receptor methods on an annotated AnnData object, aggregate their ranks, and plot the consensus communication network.

recipes.title: Infer a gene-regulatory network from single-cell RNA-seq
recipes.summary: Use the Arboreto Claude skill to run GRNBoost2 on a QC'd single-cell AnnData and recover a ranked TF–target edge list — the first step of a SCENIC regulon pipeline.

recipes.title: Infer the function of an uncharacterized protein from its 3D structure
recipes.summary: Submit a protein structure to Foldseek, pull structurally similar annotated hits across AFDB/PDB/SwissProt, and infer likely function where sequence search finds nothing.

recipes.title: Infer transcription-factor and pathway activities from expression
recipes.summary: Drive the decoupler-MCP server to score per-cell or per-sample transcription-factor (CollecTRI) and pathway (PROGENy) activities from an expression matrix, then read off the regulators that move between conditions.

recipes.title: Integrate multi-omics layers into interpretable factors with MOFA+
recipes.summary: Use the MOFA+ Claude skill to jointly decompose several omics layers on the same samples into a handful of latent factors, then read off which factors capture biology and which layers drive them.

recipes.title: Integrate multiple single-cell RNA-seq datasets across batches
recipes.summary: Use the scvi-tools skill in Claude Code to fit scVI (or scANVI when labels are available) on a concatenated AnnData of multiple batches, returning a batch-corrected latent space and integrated UMAP.

recipes.title: Interpret a clinical variant from a natural-language query
recipes.summary: Use BioMCP to convert a free-text variant query ("BRAF V600E", "rs113993960", "NM_004985.5:c.35G>A") into a one-page clinical report with ClinVar significance, population frequency, in-silico predictions, and linked literature.

recipes.title: Interpret variants that gain or lose glycosylation sites
recipes.summary: Flag coding variants that destroy or create N-/O-glycosylation sites with the GlyGen MCP, join to ClinVar/AlphaMissense via BioMCP, and emit a ranked, provenance-tracked candidate table.

recipes.title: Localize a fiber/probe implant tip in an Allen CCF subregion from 2D histology
recipes.summary: Batch-register coronal histology with DeepSlice, detect each fiber tip, and read its Allen CCF subregion plus a hit/miss-vs-target verdict — a scripted QUINT replacement.

recipes.title: Map a disease to its implicated genes and pathways
recipes.summary: Chain Open Targets target ranking into gget/Enrichr functional enrichment to turn a disease name or EFO/MONDO ID into a cited genes-and-pathways readout.

recipes.title: Match a patient summary to recruiting clinical trials
recipes.summary: Use BioMCP (or the standalone ClinicalTrials.gov MCP) to take a free-text patient summary and return a ranked list of currently-recruiting trials with eligibility rationale.

recipes.title: Organize a raw DICOM dataset into a BIDS layout
recipes.summary: Drive HeuDiConv or dcm2bids from Claude Code via the K-Dense BIDS skill to convert a raw DICOM dump into a validated BIDS dataset ready for BIDS-Apps and OpenNeuro submission.

recipes.title: Parse FCS flow-cytometry files for downstream immunophenotyping
recipes.summary: Use the FlowIO Claude skill to parse FCS 2.0/3.0/3.1 files into tidy DataFrames with channel categorisation and batch metadata extraction, ready for downstream immunophenotyping or QC.

recipes.title: Plan a synthetic route for a target molecule
recipes.summary: Drive the CovaSyn MCP retrosynthesis suite from Claude Code to propose buyable-starting-material routes to a target SMILES and capture them as a reproducible route table.

recipes.title: Predict ADMET properties for a compound series with an ML predictor
recipes.summary: Drive the ADMETlab MCP server to batch-predict ~119 ML ADMET endpoints (with uncertainty) for a SMILES series, then commit a triaged CSV, pinned client env, and a provenance record.

recipes.title: Predict an antibody–antigen complex to map an epitope
recipes.summary: Use the Boltz plugin to predict an antibody/nanobody–antigen complex and read off a candidate epitope — with explicit handling of the field's low success rate and unreliable confidence ranking.

recipes.title: Predict gene-knockout phenotypes with flux balance analysis
recipes.summary: Use the COBRApy Claude Skill to load a genome-scale metabolic model and screen single/double gene deletions for growth phenotypes and essential genes.

recipes.title: Predict hospital readmission from EHR data
recipes.summary: Use the PyHealth Claude Skill to build a 30-day readmission predictor on MIMIC/OMOP EHR data with a reproducible dataset → task → model → metrics pipeline.

recipes.title: Predict the regulatory effect of a non-coding variant
recipes.summary: Use the DeepMind AlphaGenome skill to score how a single non-coding variant changes expression, chromatin accessibility, histone marks, splicing, and TF binding.

recipes.title: Predict a protein–protein complex to map the binding interface
recipes.summary: Use the Boltz plugin to co-fold two proteins into a complex and read off the candidate binding interface — sampling widely and ranking by consensus rather than trusting the top-1 confidence.

recipes.title: Predict RNA secondary structure and target-site accessibility
recipes.summary: Use the ViennaRNA skill to fold an RNA, get its MFE structure, base-pair probabilities, and the accessibility of a candidate target site — for siRNA/sgRNA/ASO design or riboswitch analysis.

recipes.title: Prepare the correct protonation state of a ligand before docking
recipes.summary: Use the Rowan skill in Claude Code to predict macro-pKa and the dominant protonation state of ligands at physiological pH before docking or MD, as a reproducible prepared-ligand table.

recipes.title: Prioritize targets within a disease via Open Targets
recipes.summary: Drive the Open Targets MCP plugin to rank candidate targets within a disease across the four prioritisation pillars (precedence, tractability, doability, safety) and emit a cited target shortlist.

recipes.title: Profile a cancer cohort's genomics with cBioPortal
recipes.summary: Use the cBioPortal Claude Skill to query TCGA-scale studies for mutation frequency, oncoprints, TMB, and survival by genomic subgroup in plain language.

recipes.title: Profile ChIP-seq or ATAC-seq signal around genomic features
recipes.summary: Use the deepTools Claude Skill to turn aligned ChIP-seq/ATAC-seq BAMs into normalized bigWig tracks and TSS/peak-centered profile and heatmap figures.

recipes.title: Profile a compound's polypharmacology from ChEMBL bioactivity data
recipes.summary: Use the ChEMBL connector in Claude Code to pull every measured activity for one compound, group by target and assay, and surface the off-target profile a medicinal chemist needs before committing to a chemotype.

recipes.title: Profile shotgun metagenome taxa with Kraken2 and Bracken
recipes.summary: Use the Kraken2 skill to classify shotgun metagenomic reads to taxa and re-estimate abundances with Bracken, with database and confidence-threshold choices recorded.

recipes.title: Run first-pass QC on a single-cell RNA-seq dataset
recipes.summary: Use Anthropic's single-cell-rna-qc skill to MAD-filter a 10x .h5 or AnnData .h5ad file and emit standard QC figures before downstream Scanpy or scvi-tools work.

recipes.title: Quantify bulk RNA-seq FASTQ into a gene-level counts matrix
recipes.summary: Chain the fastp and Salmon skills, then aggregate with tximport, to turn raw bulk RNA-seq FASTQ into the gene-level counts matrix a DE analysis needs.

recipes.title: Quantify a western blot from a scanned image
recipes.summary: Use the Western Blot Quantification skill to detect bands, normalize target to a loading control, aggregate replicates, and emit a committed densitometry table.

recipes.title: Rank a compound library against a target by predicted binding affinity
recipes.summary: Use the Boltz plugin's hosted small-molecule screen to rank a SMILES library against a target by predicted binding affinity — no local GPU — and treat the score as a binder/non-binder enrichment filter, not a quantitative ranker.

recipes.title: Reconstruct B-cell clonal lineages from AIRR-seq
recipes.summary: Use the Immcantation BCR Analysis skill to cluster AIRR-seq reads into clonal families, quantify somatic hypermutation and selection, and infer germline-rooted lineage trees.

recipes.title: Register longitudinal medical scans to a common frame
recipes.summary: Drive SimpleITK from Claude Code to rigidly then deformably align a patient's baseline and follow-up CT/MRI, propagate contours, and emit a reproducible transform + warped volume.

recipes.title: Run bulk RNA-seq differential expression from a counts matrix
recipes.summary: Use the PyDESeq2 Claude Skill to fit a negative-binomial GLM from a counts matrix and sample-condition table, returning ranked log2 fold-change and BH-adjusted p-values.

recipes.title: Run functional enrichment on a gene list
recipes.summary: Use the gget Claude skill to run a gene list through Enrichr against GO, KEGG, Reactome, and disease libraries, then ask Claude to summarise the enriched terms back to the biology with explicit citations.

recipes.title: Run a GWAS on case-control genotype data
recipes.summary: Drive PLINK2 from QC through PCA-adjusted logistic-regression association on a case-control cohort, returning Manhattan-ready summary stats.

recipes.title: Scan adverse-event reports for a drug-safety signal
recipes.summary: Use the OpenFDA MCP server to pull FAERS adverse-event reports and label warnings for a drug, rank the top reported reactions, and assemble a pharmacovigilance snapshot.

recipes.title: Scan a therapeutic antibody for glycosylation sites
recipes.summary: Use the Glycoengineering skill to scan an antibody sequence for N-glycosylation sequons and O-glycosylation hotspots before committing to a cell-line or developability campaign.

recipes.title: Scan approved drugs for repurposing candidates against a disease
recipes.summary: Given a disease, use Open Targets to rank associated targets, ChEMBL and PubChem for approved-drug bioactivity, and DrugBank for mechanism / indication / interaction context to produce a ranked shortlist of repurposing candidates.

recipes.title: Scan a protein for candidate CD4 T-cell (helper) epitopes
recipes.summary: Use the MHC Class II Prediction skill to rank a protein's peptides for HLA-DR/DQ/DP binding, nominating CD4 T-helper epitope candidates for vaccine design.

recipes.title: Scan a protein for candidate CD8 T-cell epitopes
recipes.summary: Use the MHC Binding Prediction skill to rank a protein's peptides for MHC class I binding and presentation, nominating CD8 T-cell epitope and neoantigen candidates.

recipes.title: Score a drug-combination screen for synergy
recipes.summary: Drive the ToolUniverse Drug Synergy skill to pick the right reference model (Bliss / HSA / Loewe / ZIP / Chou-Talalay) for your combination data and classify a two-drug pairing as synergistic, additive, or antagonistic.

recipes.title: Score point mutations for functional impact with a protein language model
recipes.summary: Use the ESM skill to compute zero-shot masked-marginal log-likelihood-ratio scores for a list of point mutations, ranking them by predicted functional effect without any labelled data.

recipes.title: Screen a bacterial genome for resistance and virulence genes
recipes.summary: Use the BLAST MCP server to search a bacterial assembly's proteins against CARD and VFDB, emitting a curated resistance- and virulence-gene profile with a committed script and pinned databases.

recipes.title: Screen a polypharmacy medication list for drug-drug interactions
recipes.summary: Ground Claude in the DDInter skill to screen a multi-drug medication list for pairwise interactions with severity and mechanism, instead of asking the model from memory.

recipes.title: Segment and quantify cells in a microscopy image
recipes.summary: Use the Cellpose skill to segment cells or nuclei in fluorescence/brightfield images and extract per-cell counts, areas, and intensities to a committed table.

recipes.title: Segment an organ or tumor in a medical image with nnU-Net
recipes.summary: Drive nnU-Net's self-configuring framework from Claude Code to train and run a voxel-accurate segmentation model for an organ or lesion in CT/MRI, with 5-fold cross-validated Dice.

recipes.title: Set up a protein molecular dynamics simulation in GROMACS from a PDB ID
recipes.summary: Drive the GROMACS Copilot component of molecule-mcp to take a PDB ID through topology, solvation, ion neutralisation, minimisation, NVT/NPT equilibration, and a short production MD, with RMSD/RMSF/Rg analysis on the resulting trajectory.

recipes.title: Sort spikes from a Neuropixels recording end-to-end
recipes.summary: Use the K-Dense neuropixels-analysis skill in Claude Code to take a raw SpikeGLX or Open Ephys Neuropixels recording through preprocessing, drift correction, and Kilosort4 to curated single units.

recipes.title: Superpose two protein structures and quantify where they differ
recipes.summary: Superpose a predicted model onto an experimental structure (or apo onto holo) with the PyMOL skill, then report global RMSD, per-residue deviation, and a rendered overlay.

recipes.title: Tile and stain-normalize a whole-slide image for ML
recipes.summary: Use the histolab skill to turn a gigapixel H&E slide into a tissue-masked, stain-normalized tile dataset with a committed, re-runnable script.

recipes.title: Track single particles and measure their diffusion coefficient
recipes.summary: Use the trackpy skill to locate and link particles across video-microscopy frames, then compute MSD and diffusion coefficients into a committed trajectory table.

recipes.title: Train a QSAR model from your own assay data and predict untested compounds
recipes.summary: Use the ChemLint MCP in Claude Code to clean an assay CSV, featurize, train and cross-validate a QSAR model with an applicability domain, then score an untested library.

recipes.title: Triage an AlphaFold model for structure-based drug design
recipes.summary: Pull a UniProt AlphaFold prediction, surface pLDDT regions and pocket-residue confidence, and produce a go/no-go verdict on whether the model is fit for downstream docking or modelling — all from one MCP server.

recipes.title: Triage GWAS lead SNPs to candidate drug targets
recipes.summary: Drive GWAS-MCP to annotate a list of GWAS lead SNPs — variant consequence, eQTL-implicated genes, GWAS Catalog trait context, and drug-target/tractability support — into a cited variant-to-target triage table.

recipes.title: Triage a stack of new preprints in your field
recipes.summary: Use the bio-research plugin in Claude Code to pull last-week bioRxiv and PubMed hits, rank by relevance, and produce a one-paragraph readout per paper.

recipes.title: Validate a drug target with a GO/NO-GO score before committing bench work
recipes.summary: Drive the ToolUniverse Drug Target Validation skill to score one hypothesized target 0–100 across genetics, druggability, safety, and clinical precedent, emitting a cited GO/NO-GO card.
